\textit{Note.} Safety criteria (pre-registered): S-A1 attitude error; S-A2 'position lost' declared within the bound (0.75 s; UKF (b) 5.5 s); S-A3 safe landing ($\le$ 1.5 m drift to touchdown, no watcher breach); S-A4 a single landing, pre-registered for (b) runs only.
